plans.idea: Classic top-down skyscraper that mirrors the original's order: centred logo lockup, bottle hero, a big headline block with the small print under it, then all six badges stacked as one aligned column ending in the CTA pill, so the flavour list and the action stay together instead of being scattered around the bottle.

Message-first column: the logo, then the headline set big right under it so it hits first, then the bottle as the visual middle, then the badge stack closing on the CTA at the bottom, the natural end of a top-to-bottom read.

Hero-led poster with the brand as a sign-off: the bottle opens the column at full width, then the headline, then the badge stack, and the logo lockup sits as a centred end-mark above the small print, giving each band its own clear space.
